_about: categories.json v2 — SUPERSEDES the version in PHASE-7-ADDENDUM. Reflects Panda Patches production answers + researched embroidery/puff limits (July 2026). Save to app/pipeline/categories.json in the engine repo.

_schema.mockup: always true — EVERY type gets a realistic JPEG mockup. The mockup is the primary deliverable; it is constrained to producible detail so it never over-promises the way an AI image generator does.
_schema.mockup_style: which texture the renderer uses. embroidery|puff are built; flat_print|molded_pvc next; woven|leather|chenille|sequin start as labeled approximations.
_schema.production_file: dst = auto stitch file (embroidery+puff only). vector = SVG for mold/cut/laser/print tooling. none_manual = no auto file; specialist machine/dept makes it.
_schema.sizes: longest side in inches. max_size_in null = flexible (can be big or small). Only woven/pvc/silicone are capped at 8in.
_schema.limits: min_text_height_mm / min_line_mm / max_line_mm / max_colors drive WARNINGS shown to staff; they inform, they do not block.
_schema.color_walls: PVC/silicone only — render hard-edged color cells with a thin raised wall between colors (cloisonné look); colors never blend/bleed.
_schema.gradients_ok: true only where the process can reproduce blends (printed). Everywhere else, quantize to flat solids.

_thread_chart_note: Color snapping needs Candle threads as code+name+RGB in threads.json. The website chart is an IMAGE only — provide the official Candle RGB list or a Sanity export. Do not derive RGB from the chart image.

embroidery.label: Custom Embroidery Patches
embroidery.notes: Text <5mm illegible; warn <6mm. Lines <1mm drop out; warn <1.3mm. Solid colors only, no gradients. Max satin ~12mm.

puff_3d.label: Custom 3D Embroidered Transfers
puff_3d.notes: RESEARCHED LIMITS: columns 3-10mm (ideal 5mm); lines <2.5mm expose foam, >12mm won't hold. Bold columns only — NO thin lines, fine detail, holes, or complex shapes. Max 2 colors (foam); colors must not touch (~6mm gap). Small text must be FLAT, not puff. Always human-review before machine.

pvc.label: Custom PVC Patches
pvc.notes: Molded from vector; MAX 8in. COLOR WALLS required — render hard color cells with a thin raised divider between colors so nothing bleeds. Set every mockup parameter explicitly (size, border, base). No blends.

silicone.label: Custom Silicone Labels
silicone.notes: No stitch file — a sheet cut by plotter/laser, so vector cut path. MAX 8in. Color-walled like PVC.

leather.label: Custom Leather Patches
leather.notes: Laser engraved — vector engrave path. Typically 1-2 tones (engrave depth), not full color. Any size.

woven.label: Custom Woven Patches
woven.notes: Thin threads hold FINER detail than embroidery — good for small text/logos. MAX 8in. Rough mockup easy. Production loom file is made externally.

printed.label: Custom Printed Patches
printed.notes: Photographic — unlimited color, gradients OK, finest detail of all types. Any size. Print-ready vector/high-res raster.

chenille.label: Custom Chenille Patches
chenille.notes: Mockup only — thick yarn, big bold shapes, no small text/detail. Can be big; practical MIN ~3in. Production file made manually by the chenille dept.

chenille_tpu.label: Custom Chenille TPU Patches
chenille_tpu.notes: As chenille, TPU backing. Mockup only.

chenille_glitter.label: Custom Chenille Glitter Patches
chenille_glitter.notes: As chenille, glitter yarn. Mockup only.

sequin.label: Custom Sequin Patches
sequin.notes: Mockup only — sequins ~7mm are coarse, large bold designs only. Can be big; practical MIN ~3in. Production file made via specialist sequin software.
